b0e66dd2ef.q: How did Brian Covey achieve single-digit body fat percentage in 90 days?
b0e66dd2ef.a: Brian set a specific goal to get under 12% body fat in 90 days, starting from close to 17%. He combined multiple factors including blood work, in-body scans, jogging over 400 miles in a year, dialing in nutrition through trial and error, increasing water intake, and tracking metabolic rate and muscle gain. The first 30 days focused on building foundation and increasing metabolic rate, then he saw meaningful progress as flywheels started moving. He achieved 11.5% body fat before his family trip and continued pushing to reach single digits (8.3%) in the subsequent 90 days.

25be7c8882.q: What is Brian Covey's approach to defining personal success standards?
25be7c8882.a: Brian emphasizes that no one else should define what success looks like for you, as chasing someone else's definition leads to emptiness even if achieved. He learned through experience that following external standards set by others in your industry can lead you in the wrong direction. Instead, he advocates getting crystal clear on your own mission and standard before the new year, understanding your real dreams and desires, and setting goals much higher than industry benchmarks if that aligns with your personal vision.

cabe57a1e0.q: What specific metrics did Brian Covey use to track fitness progress?
cabe57a1e0.a: Brian used in-body scans to measure body composition changes, tracking body fat percentage weekly initially then moving to every two weeks for more meaningful progress data. He monitored metabolic rate increases, muscle gain, and paid attention to which foods worked well for his body versus those that did not.
